summarize_CRYSTALLIZATION_AIDS: summarize the CRYSTALLIZATION_AIDS constant containing PDB ligand codes for crystallization aids
summarize_LIGAND_EXCLUSION_SET: summarize the LIGAND_EXCLUSION_SET constant listing PDB ligand codes to exclude from AlphaFold predictions
summarize_CCD_CODES_DEFINING_GLYCANS: summarize the CCD_CODES_DEFINING_GLYCANS constant with glycan-defining Chemical Component Dictionary codes
summarize_STANDARD_RESIDUES: summarize the STANDARD_RESIDUES constant listing standard protein and nucleic acid residue codes
summarize_IONS: summarize the IONS constant containing ion PDB residue codes used in AlphaFold structure prediction
